structured_contextual_research.limits: Two blind LLM editorial raters reviewed the same small clustered panel in opposite directions. This measures cross-rater reproducibility, not independent human field accuracy; borderline labels abstain.

reason_labelled_retrieval.limits: Retrieval needs repeated, source-bound edits from a real writer before a field-quality lift can be estimated. It remains advisory and cannot bypass fidelity or safety gates.

blind_evaluation_lane.gain: Adds an independently split release-research lane and exposes unresolved labels; it does not change a draft or score.

production_verdict.reason: Against v2.5.7, the candidate corrects five false negatives and no consensus clean item on the frozen LLM-rated panel. The contextual lane remains release research because neither result is independent human field accuracy.
production_verdict.promotion_requirement: Any future production change needs an independently human-labelled, source-grouped field set showing a material quality gain without fidelity, subgroup, latency, or cost regression.
